combo1.title: Alien FTK: Premature Burial Loop into Machu Mech and Dark Strike Fighter
combo1.description: A three-card first-turn kill. Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar returns your face-up Spells to your hand and places an A-Counter for each one, so Premature Burial revives Gol'gar over and over while Code A Ancient Ruins spends the counters to bring Alien Ammonite back. Each revival opens a new Synchro or Link Summon: Nothung burns 800, Worldsea Dragon Zealantis resets every monster, and Geonator Transverser gives your opponent Ancient Sacred Wyvern. The 7200 LP you spend on Burials pumps that Wyvern to 8500 ATK under their control, and Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech burns them for the 6400 difference. Dark Strike Fighter Tributes itself for the last 1400. Your opponent never gets a turn. Starting hand: Alien Ammonite + Unexpected Dai + Premature Burial. Deck: Alien Shocktrooper, Code A Ancient Ruins, Black Garden. Extra Deck: Gol'gar, M-Frame, Zer'oll, Nothung, Ancient Sacred Wyvern, Zealantis, Garden Rose Maiden, Geonator Transverser, Saryuja Skull Dread, Muddy Mudragon, Dark Strike Fighter, Machu Mech. A hand trap that stops Gol'gar or Premature Burial ends the loop, and you finish on 800 LP.

steps.text: Activate Unexpected Dai. You control no monsters, so it can bring a Level 4 or lower Normal Monster out of your Deck.
Special Summon Alien Shocktrooper from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai resolves and goes to the Graveyard.
Normal Summon Alien Ammonite. Its trigger has no Alien in the Graveyard to revive yet, so let it pass.
Alien Shocktrooper becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material. Gol'gar has to use Alien Ammonite as its Tuner, plus non-Tuner Alien monsters.
Synchro Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar (Level 1 + Level 4). This is the engine of the whole turn: it bounces your face-up Spells back to your hand and turns each one into an A-Counter.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (you: 7200) and target Alien Ammonite in your Graveyard.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite in Attack Position. Premature Burial stays on the field, attached to it.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return face-up Premature Burial to your hand and place 1 A-Counter on a monster. Burial leaves without being destroyed, so Ammonite stays.
Premature Burial returns to your hand, ready to be played again.
Alien Ammonite becomes Link Material.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes the second Reptile material.
Link Summon Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame (2 Reptile monsters).
Activate Premature Burial again: pay 800 LP (6400) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. It came out properly the first time, so it can be revived.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. It is a new card on the field, so its once-per-turn effect is fresh. Return Premature Burial and place 1 A-Counter.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Link Material.
Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame becomes Link Material. As a Link-2 it counts as 2.
Link Summon Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll (Link-3, 2+ Reptile monsters).
Activate effect: Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll's on-summon effect. Add a card from your Deck that has an effect that places A-Counters.
Add Code A Ancient Ruins to your hand. It gains an A-Counter whenever a face-up Alien is destroyed, so it qualifies.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins, a Continuous Spell.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (5600) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.

Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins, so you place 2 A-Counters. This is the loop: every Burial revives Gol'gar, and every Gol'gar pays for the next Code A.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand. Once you activate it again it is a new card, so its once-per-turn effect resets.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins again.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove the 2 A-Counters Gol'gar just placed to bring back an Alien from your Graveyard.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight (Level 5 + Level 1).
Activate effect: Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight was Special Summoned. Inflict 800 damage to your opponent (8000 to 7200). They control no monsters, so the ATK loss does nothing.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (4800) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins for 2 more A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material. Ancient Sacred Wyvern needs a LIGHT Tuner, and Ammonite is LIGHT.
Synchro Summon Ancient Sacred Wyvern (Level 6 + Level 1). Its ATK goes up or down by the gap between its controller's LP and the other player's LP. Keep an eye on it: it becomes the finisher.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Link Material.
Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll becomes Link Material. As a Link-3 it counts as 3.
Link Summon Worldsea Dragon Zealantis (Link-4, 1+ Effect Monsters).
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (4000) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins for 2 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Activate effect: Worldsea Dragon Zealantis. Banish every monster on the field, then bring back as many of them as possible. Each one returns as a new card, so Gol'gar's effect is fresh again.
Ancient Sacred Wyvern is banished.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar is banished.
Alien Ammonite is banished.
Worldsea Dragon Zealantis banishes itself too.
Zealantis Special Summons Alien Ammonite back from banishment.
Ancient Sacred Wyvern returns. It came out properly the first time, so it can come back.
Worldsea Dragon Zealantis returns to a Main Monster Zone, which frees the Extra Monster Zone for later.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar returns.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (3200) and target Alien Shocktrooper.
Special Summon Alien Shocktrooper.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins for 2 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Alien Shocktrooper becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Garden Rose Maiden (Level 1 + Level 4).
Activate effect: Garden Rose Maiden was Special Summoned. Add Black Garden from your Deck.
Add Black Garden to your hand.

Activate Black Garden. From now on, each monster summoned face-up has its ATK halved, and its controller gives the other player a Rose Token. The tokens you give away appear on your opponent's field, which this board doesn't show.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Ammonite's ATK is halved and you give your opponent Rose Token 1.
Alien Ammonite becomes Link Material.
Worldsea Dragon Zealantis becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Geonator Transverser (2 Effect Monsters). Its bottom-left arrow points at Ancient Sacred Wyvern, and its top-right arrow points at a Rose Token on your opponent's side.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Geonator's ATK is halved and your opponent gets Rose Token 2.
Activate effect: Geonator Transverser. It points to 2 monsters, so switch control of Ancient Sacred Wyvern and that Rose Token.
Ancient Sacred Wyvern moves to your opponent's field. From now on its ATK rises by their LP minus yours, and each Premature Burial widens that gap.
You take control of the Rose Token.
The Rose Token becomes Link Material. A Token used as material simply ceases to exist.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Link Material.
Geonator Transverser becomes Link Material. As a Link-2 it counts as 2.

Link Summon Saryuja Skull Dread (Link-4) with 3 materials that have different names. Three materials give it two effects: monsters summoned to zones it points to gain 300 ATK/DEF, and once per turn it can Special Summon a monster from your hand.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Saryuja's ATK is halved and your opponent gets Rose Token 3.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (2400) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Gol'gar's ATK is halved and your opponent gets Rose Token 4.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Gol'gar arrived in a zone it points to, so Gol'gar gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial, Code A Ancient Ruins and Black Garden: 3 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Black Garden returns to your hand. With it gone, your next summons don't hand out Rose Tokens.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Muddy Mudragon (Level 5 + Level 1).
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Muddy Mudragon gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (1600) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate Black Garden again. Gol'gar is already on the field, so it isn't halved, and Black Garden gives Gol'gar a third face-up card to return.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial, Code A Ancient Ruins and Black Garden for 3 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Black Garden returns to your hand.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Alien Ammonite gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Muddy Mudragon becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Dark Strike Fighter (Level 1 + Level 6). In Main Phase 1 it can Tribute a monster to burn for that monster's Level x 200.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Dark Strike Fighter gains 300 ATK/DEF.

Activate Premature Burial one last time: pay 800 LP and target Alien Shocktrooper. You are down to 800 LP while your opponent is still on 7200, so the Wyvern they control is at 2100 + 6400 = 8500 ATK.
Special Summon Alien Shocktrooper.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Alien Shocktrooper gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar's second effect. Remove 2 A-Counters to destroy 1 card your opponent controls: one of the Rose Tokens.
Xyz Summon Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech (2 Level 5 monsters).
Garden Rose Maiden becomes Xyz Material.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes the second material.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Machu Mech gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate effect: Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech. Target Ancient Sacred Wyvern on your opponent's field: its original ATK is 2100 and its current ATK is 8500.
Detach Garden Rose Maiden as the cost.
Machu Mech inflicts the 6400 difference as damage (your opponent: 7200 to 800) and gains that much ATK.
Activate effect: Garden Rose Maiden in your Graveyard. Banish it and target a Dragon Synchro Monster in your Graveyard.
Banish Garden Rose Maiden as the cost.
Special Summon Muddy Mudragon from your Graveyard. The replay does this before the last burn, but the duel is already won without it.
Activate effect: Dark Strike Fighter. It is still Main Phase 1: Tribute a monster to inflict its Level x 200 as damage.
Tribute Dark Strike Fighter itself. It is Level 7, so your opponent takes 1400 damage with 800 LP left, and the duel ends on the first turn.
